definition: To move code from a local or staging environment into production where users can access it.

examples.en: We need to deploy the new feature to production today.
examples.es: Necesitamos desplegar la nueva funcionalidad a producción hoy.

definition: Improve internal code structure without changing its external behavior.

examples.en: We should refactor this authentication component before deploying.
examples.es: Deberíamos refactorizar este componente de autenticación antes de desplegar.

definition: A proposal to merge changes from a feature branch into the main codebase.

examples.en: I opened a pull request for the login fix and tagged two reviewers.
examples.es: Abrí una solicitud de cambios para la corrección del login y etiqueté a dos revisores.

definition: A set of automated processes that execute builds, tests, and deployments.

examples.en: The CI/CD pipeline failed during unit tests.
examples.es: El flujo automatizado falló durante las pruebas unitarias.

definition: A point of congestion in a system that slows down the overall performance.

examples.en: The database queries are the main bottleneck in our application.
examples.es: Las consultas a la base de datos son el principal cuello de botella en nuestra aplicación.
